patterns.skill_gap: A tree can be edited by sibling lanes while a read-only audit is running: hash the scope files up front, re-grep every line citation at write time, and state the snapshot. Two citations in this run were already fixed by their owning lane before the report landed.
patterns.what_was_hard: Separating code-derived cost (call counts per tick) from runtime cost (no in-client profile exists), and keeping per-frame work attributable when one class hook fans out to HUD, guide and practice on the same tick.
patterns.what_worked: Tracing every driver to its installing line and proving the idle off-path per frame (hidden-frame OnUpdate blocked, wiki); counting registrations against the client branch docs; using the paladin's own combat-exit reset as evidence for the missing bar-side reset.
